notes:
BUILD 72
- Armored Car: a steel box on wheels. Most health of anything (1800), quicker than the truck and slower than the pick-up, slits to see out of, and whatever is shot at you inside it hits the car instead.
- Dirt Bike: quick and light, leans into corners. Its engine needs only pistons, spark plugs and a carburetor, the parts last two and a half times as long, and it sips fuel. No cargo.
- Both turn up on the roads (the armored car rarely). /car armored and /car bike in dev.
- Armour plate for the pick-up, buggy and truck: in the engine menu, with a wrench on you, for 10 sheet metal, 15 high quality metal and 50 scrap. Plates show on the car, take two fifths off every hit, and cost a little acceleration (not top speed).
- Jack (200 metal fragments and a gear, level 1 bench): use it on a car that has gone over and it is wound slowly back onto its wheels.
- Headlamps on every car and the minicopter: N switches them.
- Wheels are solid: no more seeing through the rims. Springs now stand on proper seats, and are left off where the bodywork would hide them.
